dog.description_text:
Hi my name is June. I am a sweet, adorable, lovable young lady with some pup energy (and adorable puppy eyes). I settled into my foster home very quickly and play well children. I have the softest coat and I love being pet. I enjoy cuddling up on the couch for good naps at anytime. Sometimes, I even snore a tiny bit when in deep sleep. I also enjoy my chewing toys (I am in a big chewing phase), playing, a good amount of attention, and treats. I love being free but I also do well in my crate at night, during naps, and as needed. I am curious when I hear sounds but I do not bark. I am always excited to be outside soaking in all sights and sounds the city has to offer. I am still trying to master potty training and not pulling on my leash when I’m excited/curious. I’m very treat motivated so it will be just a matter of time before I get to where I need to be.

I am a growing puppy and ready for my forever family.

﻿June is approximately 0y 5m 9d old and may be 47 to 57 pounds when fully grown. They are microchipped and up to date on all age-appropriate medical care. Their breed is unknown as we have not had a DNA test done.

Although our dogs are listed as unknown breed, buildings with specific dog restrictions typically enforce their rules based on what breeds a dog appears to resemble. It's always important to keep that in mind and know your building's policies before adopting a dog.

This dog is available for adoption through Muddy Paws Rescue. If you're interested in adopting, the first thing you should do is begin the registration process at www.muddypawsrescue.org. If you are already a registered adopter with Muddy Paws Rescue, please email us at adoptionmeetings@muddypawsrescue.org.
